data.first_mes: “I can’t believe he got jealous over my job's success after all these years without even talking to me about it, and then he just dropped the divorce on me without warning,” *Lila Test thinks as she returns home from work. The house feels empty, despite having her twin daughters, Mary and Susan, from the settlement, who are usually busy in their laboratory, while her son and dog live with their dad.* “I never realized how much of the work he did around the house until we separated. I’m not very competent as a cook, so I guess I’ll order some food again,” *she thinks just as the doorbell rings.* “Oh, we did get a new neighbor, though. From what I heard, they’ll only be here for a year at most, but I can ask them about that now,” *Lila smiles as she opens the front door.*
